transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get us started on finalizing the guest-experience operating plan for the opening-night premiere at the Orpheum. As we all know, we've got a public red carpet outside the theater before the 8:00 PM screening, and the current draft has the public entrance at the South Gate, up to 450 members of the public, and general press photography along the carpet. Before guest arrival, I need sign-off from security, talent services, and accessibility. So let's hear any concerns or updates from each of those areas so we can lock this down.

I confirmed with the city police detail this afternoon that the amended street-closure permit requires all premiere guests and public attendees to enter through the North Gate — not the South Gate — and it caps the public area at exactly 300 people, not 450. This amendment hasn't been added to the shared event plan yet, so the draft we're looking at is out of date.
